systems.system: Point d'Echange Internet du Mali (GIE MLIX)
systems.owner: Groupement d'Interet Economique to operate and maintain it; steering committee chaired by the ICT minister

note: Decree of 24 October 2017 creates the steering committee for setting up the exchange point; it states no exchange in service, members or traffic.

facts.fact: ECOWAS SIGTEL's regional inventory lists one Internet Exchange Point in Mali, Mali IX (MLIX) in Bamako, among 14 in the ECOWAS member states; no member count or traffic is given. The page carries no date, so as_of is its published date.

note: Passages name MLI nowhere; the exchange point mentioned (CENIX) is in the Central African Republic.
Names exchanges only in South Africa, Kenya and Nigeria; Mali appears only in a Starlink schedule list.
Names only foreign exchanges (FranceIX, AMS-IX, WAFIX Lagos) where Afribone peers; no exchange in Mali.
The document states nothing this study asks for this country.
Lists a study on the history of IXPs in Mali but states no exchange in service.

facts.fact: Internet Society Pulse's IXP Tracker lists 1 active exchange point in Mali with 7 members as of November 2026.
The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for Mali: MLIX, Bamako.
